title: Holiday Bonus Gift Card Offer — Terms of the Promotion
content:
During the bonus promotion, an order placed from 27 November 2026 through 24 December 2026 (Eastern Time, both days included) that buys gift cards earns one Bonus Gift Card worth 20.00 for every whole 100.00 of gift card lines on that order, capped at the Bonus Gift Card's maximum balance of 100.00. The Bonus Gift Card is part of Gift Cards & Store Credit.

## Terms

1. Gift card value bought on separate orders is never combined.
2. The bonus card is issued on the order's dispatch date to the purchaser, and is spendable only from its valid-from date.
3. Orders placed outside the promotion earn no bonus, and a bonus is never issued afterwards for an order that missed it.

## Order dates (Eastern Time)

| Order placed | Inside the promotion? |
|---|---|
| 26 November 2026, 11:59 pm | No |
| 27 November 2026, any time | Yes (first day included) |
| 24 December 2026, any time | Yes (last day included) |
| 25 December 2026, any time | No |

## Bonus value (hypothetical orders placed inside the promotion)

| Gift card lines on the one order | Whole 100.00 blocks | Bonus value at 20.00 per block | After the 100.00 cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No bonus |
| 250.00 | 2 | 40.00 | 40.00 |
| 700.00 | 7 | 140.00 | 100.00 |

Two orders of 60.00 of gift cards each earn no bonus: the 120.00 is bought on separate orders and is never combined into a block.
